name: liquid-marbling-swirl
title: Liquid Marbling Swirl
description: Viscous paper marbling Ebru ink fluid swirls with smooth harmonic color currents.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Soft
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Pastel

## Rules

- Passive Marbling Currents: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
